before: The band synthesized for a wrapTopAndBottom drawing's own paragraph added a paragraph-relative vertical offset to the anchor line's top, so an anchor on a later line put the band below the drawing.
after: A paragraph-relative offset is measured from the paragraph's top and a line-relative one from the anchor line's, as the drawing itself is placed.
reason: Only local layout changes. Nothing about layout enters shared state, operations, snapshots or protocol messages.
